description:
Outcome: gardener sees own allocated plot and season dates, from brief.md First version 3.
Scope: private own allocation/dates, awaiting-allocation and waiting-list states. Excludes: coordinator plot map, all-plot holder overview and other households' records.
Acceptance: displayed allocation/dates match canonical records after save/refresh; no other household details exposed.
Behaviour: readable mobile/keyboard layout with loading, empty, stale and error recovery; sensitive view not retained after logout.
Verification: allocated/pending/waitlisted end-to-end fixtures, role isolation and phone/zoom checks. Prerequisites: prototype checkpoint and allocation workflow. Assumptions: no allocation emails.
title: Gardener allocation and season view
